name: Edict of Steel / owned Axe is not Sword
printed_text:
**Sharpen** target sword you control.

If it has 1 or more +1{p} counters, create a Flurry token.

**Go again**
format_scope: Four genuinely manual legal young natural20 Heroes. Actual owned ready Axe does not satisfy target Sword. First a real cost0 Instant is played and allfour seats respond, proving ACTION AP1 and HP21 before the primary cost0 click. Refusal is not caused by owner/class/AP/cost/window. Primary remains same physical Hand card, asset unchanged, no effect/cost/GA/token/newUID. No primary positive ability or target timing credit.
